title: Community-Driven API and AI Writer Design for Openly Scaling Community Notes
abstract: arXiv:2609.40067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Community Notes is a crowd-sourced approach for adding context to posts on X. Contributors propose and rate notes, forming the inputs to an open-source, open-data algorithm that determines which notes show broadly to users. Since September 2025, Community Notes' AI Note Writer API has provided an open, public interface for using AI to propose notes, while adhering to the founding principle that users, not the platform or an AI, control which notes show on X. Explicit note requests and user posts on X determine the AI API post feeds, ensuring that AI note writing responds to demand from X users. We present the design, operation and impact of the AI API, including analysis of the interaction between AI and human generated notes across topics. translated_title: 面向开放扩展社区笔记的社区驱动 API 与 AI 写作器设计
translated_abstract: 社区笔记是一种为 X 平台上的帖子添加背景信息的众包方式。贡献者撰写并评分笔记，这些内容构成了一个开源、开放数据算法的输入，该算法决定哪些笔记会广泛展示给用户。自2025年9月以来，社区笔记的 AI 笔记写作器 API 提供了一个开放的公共接口，允许使用 AI 来撰写笔记，同时坚持其创立原则：由用户而非平台或 AI 来控制哪些笔记在 X 上展示。明确的笔记请求和 X 用户的帖子共同决定了 AI API 的帖子信息流，确保 AI 笔记写作能够响应 X 用户的需求。我们介绍了该 AI API 的设计、运行和影响，包括对 AI 生成笔记与人类生成笔记在不同主题上互动情况的分析。除非另有说明，所有测量和系统描述反映的是2026年6月2日至29日的情况。Community Writer 是最大的 AI API 客户端，贡献了 AI API 输出的大部分，生成了52%的……
tldr: 本文介绍了 X 平台社区笔记的 AI 笔记写作器 API 的设计与运行，该开放接口使 AI 能够撰写笔记，但坚持由用户而非平台或 AI 决定笔记是否展示的原则，并确保 AI 笔记响应 X 用户的真实需求。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the design, operation, and impact of Community Notes' AI Note Writer API on X, an open public interface enabling AI to write notes while adhering to the principle that users—not the platform or AI—control which notes are shown, ensuring AI note writing responds to real user demand.
